name: order_blood_cultures
description: Orders blood cultures to detect bacteremia or fungemia. Typically involves draws from two separate sites. Used in sepsis workup, fever of unknown origin, and suspected endocarditis.

number_of_sets.description: Number of blood culture sets to collect (typically 2-3)

number_of_bottles_per_set.description: Number of bottles per set (aerobic/anaerobic, typically 2)

collection_site.description: Sites of venipuncture (e.g., left antecubital fossa, right antecubital fossa)

antibiotic_already_given.description: Whether antibiotics have already been administered

when_to_use: Post-surgical fever with concern for bloodstream infection

examples.query: Draw blood cultures from two sites, patient is febrile and septic
